content.comment_body: I'm looking to confirm whether this [product_name] expansion module, with article number [article_no], is compatible with the [product_name] base logic module, which has display and article number [article_no].

All expansion modules ending with [article_no] are compatible with base modules ending in [article_no]. Your base module will work with the expansion module. However, keep in mind: if the base module uses a 24 VAC power supply, the expansion module will require its own power supply, either 12 VDC or 24 VDC.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is checking the compatibility of an expansion module and a base module for a specific control system. Compatibility is confirmed, but it's mentioned that separate power supplies may be required depending on the type of base module.
